items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: on that band was a guy by the name of Chester Boone that liked my playing, and he had formed a band in Houston

ctx.x: Now, we went out like 3 months all over the state of Louisiana, because he is from Louisiana. I come back here and I go back to school in September. Now, on that band was a guy by the name of Chester Boone that liked my playing, and he had formed a band in Houston, and went into the Harlem Grill here in Houston, Texas.
No, I said Chester. C-h-e-s-t-e-r, Chester Boone
